fields.place: Navadvīpa (house of Śrīvāsa); her husband's home at Kumārahaṭṭa (Hālisahara)
fields.notes:
Daughter of Nalina Paṇḍita, elder brother of Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita; mother of Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, author of the Caitanya-bhāgavata. «Nārāyaṇī ate the remnants of Śrī Caitanya; from her womb Vṛndāvana dāsa was born» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 8.41). Her husband Vaikuṇṭhanātha Vipra of Kumārahaṭṭa died while she was pregnant, and she came back to Śrīvāsa's house in Navadvīpa (Prema-vilāsa 23). The Lord loved her from childhood and gave her the betel He had chewed. She told her son that Locana dāsa had rightly described the Lord's last night with Viṣṇupriyā, for she was one of the sakhīs there.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Kilimbikā, Ambikā's sister, who ate Kṛṣṇa's remnants (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 43; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

A brāhmaṇa woman, the nurse (dhātrī-mātā) of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu (Jayānanda's Caitanya-maṅgala 2; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna, which gives her a separate entry from Nārāyaṇī Devī, Vṛndāvana dāsa's mother). Jayānanda also calls her the sister of Śrīvāsa's wife and Kilimbikā in Kṛṣṇa-līlā; the Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā (43) and the Abhidhāna give Kilimbikā to Nārāyaṇī Devī, Śrīvāsa's niece.
